title: From blank page to working model, fast
summary: Watch how Model Designer brings cloud based pharmacometric modeling to your browser, with guided wizards, live PML editing, and AI assistance from Certara.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


Get a quick look at Model Designer, Certara’s browser-based tool for pharmacometric modeling. This short video highlights the guided wizards, live model view, and annotated PML that make it approachable whether you are new to modeling or writing PML from scratch. Contact us for a full demo.


### View transcript


Building a PKPD model used to mean knowing every detail upfront. With Model Designer, you don’t.


Just answer a few guided questions. How the drug’s absorbed?


How it distributes?


How it is cleared?


And the wizard builds your model step by step, previewing each choice along the way.


From there, you land on the model detail page where everything comes together. Your model structure on the left, live simulation plots in the center, and fully annotated modeling language on the right, all updating instantly as you adjust parameters.


Need answers fast? The AI powered guidance tab explains your model in plain language, right when you need it. And because every setting lives in the URL, sharing a model is as simple as sharing a link.


No exporting, no setup.


Prefer to start from something proven? Browse the model library for author defined models straight from the literature, ready to adapt. This is Model Designer from Idea to Insight in minutes.


## Explore the engine behind Model Designer


Model Designer and the NLME MCP Server are built on Phoenix, the fastest, best converging NLME engine on the market. See how Phoenix supports PK, PD, popPK, and toxicokinetic analysis across your programs.


[Explore Phoenix](https://www.certara.com/software/phoenix-pkpd/)[Contact the Certara team](https://www.certara.com/software/phoenix-pkpd/phoenix-cloud/#Contact-us-CTA)
